scripts.lint: oxlint app components utils next.config.mjs postcss.config.mjs
scripts.format: oxfmt --write app components content utils source.config.ts next.config.mjs postcss.config.mjs package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.json vercel.json README.md .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check app components content utils source.config.ts next.config.mjs postcss.config.mjs package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.json vercel.json README.md .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm build
